purpose: Teach: 照らし/記さ/屈し/残留/広範囲/生じる/通念/護衛

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、街灯が照らした通りを警察、捜査しております
lines.en: We're currently investigating the street that was lit by the streetlights.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Slight pause after the fact statement. Even pace. Respectful tone—informing without lecturing. Voice stays level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、記された手書きメモを警察、解読されたんですね
lines.en: So the police have already decoded the handwritten notes found at the scene?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not challenging. Voice lifts slightly at the question. Leans forward slightly. Thoughtful pause before speaking—he's processing what this means.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者が屈した取調べを警察、進めました
lines.en: We've advanced the interrogation with the suspect to that point.
lines.style: Factual, measured. No tone shift. Steady pace. Professional distance maintained. Voice neither accelerates nor softens—just clear reporting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現場に残留した毛髪を警察、鑑定されたんですね
lines.en: So the police have also examined the hair samples left at the scene?
lines.style: Quiet realization dawning. Slower pace. Gentle curiosity—not pressing, observing. Slight lift at the end of the question. He's connecting pieces aloud.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、広範囲の捜索を続けております
lines.en: We're continuing a wide-range search of the area.
lines.style: Calm, steady statement. Professional rhythm. No urgency in the delivery—just factual continuation. Voice remains composed and measured throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者に生じる影響を警察、配慮されているそうですね
lines.en: I hear the police are being thoughtful about the impact this has on the victim as well.
lines.style: Soft, careful phrasing. Slower pace. Voice carries warmth—acknowledging humanity in procedure. Slight hesitation before 'impact,' checking for sensitivity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、社会通念に反する行為を摘発いたします
lines.en: The police will take action against any conduct that violates public standards.
lines.style: Formal, resolute opening. Voice carries weight without aggression. Measured pace. This is a statement of principle—steady and clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 要人の護衛、警察、強化いただきありがたいです
lines.en: We're grateful that the police have strengthened their protection for the VIP.
lines.style: Warm, sincere gratitude. Voice softens. Slower pace. Genuine relief underneath. Not effusive—just honest appreciation for reassurance.
